purpose: Classify the five incomplete benchmark-app rows left by Goal4723 before spending POD time. The audit separates partial operator coverage, measured no-win candidates, no-route blockers, and deferred app-identity/subprobe cases so none can be used as a V4 app-level result by implication.

next_goals: Goal4726 robot_collision full-route or same-primitive improvement protocol
Goal4727 contact_manifold no-go or fresh generic bounded witness protocol
Goal4729 barnes_hut generic aggregate weighted workflow or no-go
Goal4730 complete app-level V2.14-vs-V4 matrix rerun only after Goals4725-4729 close

rows.current_v4_status: V4 has generic ray-triangle any-hit flag operator coverage and an app adapter reducing ray flags to pose flags with Torch/CuPy, but the promoted app route/planning contract is not complete.

Torch/CuPy pose-flag reduction by itself is a V4 speed win
same primitive productization is a V4 speed win without a frozen V2.14 denominator
rows.goal4726_exit_condition: Either a complete same-hardware V2.14-vs-V4 app row with correctness parity and explicit same-primitive denominator, or a no-go row explaining why robot_collision cannot support V4 high-performance claims.

contact-specific fused witness native kernel is allowed
